summary: Todo REST API with a swappable storage layer and a minimal web frontend

architecture.backend: route -> service -> store; store is an interface so an in-memory impl swaps for a DB later
architecture.frontend: plain TypeScript + DOM, no build step
architecture.designSystem: single accent color, system font, 8px spacing scale
notes: the zod schema doubles as the API contract and the test fixture

lessons: Defining the storage layer as an interface up front let backend-impl agents work without waiting on a database decision.
3-vote verify caught two routes that returned 200 on a missing id instead of 404.
Feeding the zod schema into every agent prompt removed almost all schema-mismatch retries.
pitfalls: The first test-sweep round oscillated because agents fixed and re-broke the same route; deduping targets by route path fixed it.
